name: resource_fit
purpose: Say whether measured resource use fits the described workload (resource_critic). Budgets decide approval.

fields.name: workload
fields.meaning: What the process was doing while it was sampled, as the caller described it.

fields.name: usage
fields.meaning: Measured use written by code in fixed words: CPU, memory level and trend, handles, disk and GPU.

ask.instructions: Is the use in `usage` what `workload` would need?
ask.yes: every resource in `usage` is in line with the work `workload` describes
ask.no: some resource in `usage` is far beyond what `workload` needs

gate.why: measured 2026-09-27: Kev called a 1,120 MB/min leak reasonable; budgets decide
